title: Withdrawal button and cancellation button
description: How to withdraw from a Savlo subscription within 10 days or cancel it at any time, without signing in or giving a reason. Argentine Law 24.240 and Disposition 954/2025.

content.text: This page is Savlo's BOTÓN DE ARREPENTIMIENTO (withdrawal button) and BOTÓN DE BAJA (cancellation button), under Argentina's Consumer Protection Law 24.240 and Disposition 954/2025 of the Undersecretariat for Consumer Protection and Fair Trade.
This is a translation for your convenience. The version that counts legally is the Spanish one, at savloapp.com/es/arrepentimiento. Both work the same way: you can use either.
You don't need to sign up, sign in or go through any prior step to use it. We only ask for the minimum details needed to confirm the request is yours and to find your subscription.
If you took out a Savlo subscription 10 calendar days ago or less, you can withdraw at no cost and without giving any reason. We refund the full amount.

items: Include your Savlo account email and the approximate date you subscribed.
That's it. Nothing else is needed.

content.text: We confirm we received it and send you a record of your request within 24 hours. The refund is processed by Google Play, which charged the subscription, to the same payment method you used.
The 10 days run from the day you subscribed. If they have passed, you lose nothing: you can still cancel, just below.

sections.heading: Cancellation button — cancel at any time

content.text: You can cancel your subscription whenever you want, without explaining why. There are two ways, and both are valid.
Way 1 — ask us. Write to support@savloapp.com with the subject BAJA (cancellation) and your account email. We send you the cancellation record within 24 hours of receiving the request.

Way 2 — do it yourself, right away. Google Play charges the subscription, so you can also cancel it there without going through us: open Play Store → your profile picture → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Savlo → Cancel subscription.
Either way, the cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you already paid for, and you keep access until then.

sections.heading: Cancelling is not the same as deleting your account

content.text: They are two different things, and you can do one, the other, or both:

items: Cancelling the subscription: you stop paying. Your account and your data still exist, and you can subscribe again whenever you want.

Deleting the account: your account and all your data are erased, permanently. You do it from Settings → Account & profile → Personal information → Delete account in the app, or from savloapp.com/delete-account.

content.text: Removing the app from your phone does neither: the subscription keeps being charged until you cancel it.

Write to support@savloapp.com and we'll sort it out. If you prefer an official channel, you can file a complaint with Argentina's Ventanilla Única Federal de Defensa del Consumidor, at argentina.gob.ar/produccion/defensadelconsumidor, or with the consumer protection authority of your province or municipality.
